A small '''island''' was located off the northern coast of the island [[Avilatan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the [[Separatist War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] maintained a [[Imperial Listening Post|listening post]] underneath the island.
